_about: The one place that says how a low-risk Claude call is served when the Claude pool is exhausted (T14/T15). Read by bin/escalate.sh and bin/omniroute-run.sh; check it with `bin/omniroute-run.sh --check`. Changing a provider, model, fallback order or list is an edit of this file plus `bin/omniroute-run-selftest.sh`; no code names a model or provider. Model names are whatever the gateway accepts (its provider picker); the model below was chosen from a live probe (see _chosen_by): use whatever the gateway's /v1/models lists for the provider you picked. Turning `enabled` on needs a non-empty providers.allow (the runner refuses otherwise); the gateway's install folder (install_dir) is how the runner knows the process on its port is the real one. prompt_block_patterns: a prompt that matches any of these extended regexes is never sent to the gateway (it is queued instead); the match is never logged.
_chosen_by: Live probe 2026-11-10 (copied into PLAN.md): of three free models probed, the first answered 200 in 1245 ms (cost recorded 0 on its later calls), the second 200 in 5495 ms (cost not recorded by the first runner version), the third 403 after 21.7 s; "auto" returned 402 on this $0-credit account. The choice is data in this file; change it here and re-probe.
